metrics.acceptance: experiment q13_accept: each arm on init states 0-9 (never used to fit a token), 10 episodes, noise seed 1

arms.form: bindw4@rho0.7_approach (the demo's 4 KB object prototype, no simulator state)
arms.token: ftoken@self_q102 (tasks of q10_main) / ftoken@self_w2 (43, 52 of q6_main): the tokens already folded

metrics.bytes: kept arm: policy 0, token 18432, form 4096 per task
metrics.disclosure: the rule was proposed after seeing q6_main and q10_main: there, choosing between form and token by the fold-round practice (states 10-29) would have given 91 of 180 against 52 zero-shot (form 83, token 75). The tasks are the same 9 (no other LIBERO-90 task passes the screen); the episodes, noise and acceptance states are new

hypotheses.H1: kept arm > policy, pooled over the 9 tasks (exact sign test on discordant pairs by init state)
hypotheses.H2: token > policy pooled (replication of q10 H1 at a new seed)
hypotheses.H3: form > policy pooled (replication of q10 H2)

metrics.rule: keep the arm with the most acceptance successes; ties go to the policy, then the token, then the form
metrics.test: experiment q13_main: all three arms on init states 30-49, 20 episodes, noise seed 1 (fresh draws; q6/q10 used seed 0)
metrics.written_before: any episode of q13_accept or q13_main
